Exported Functions

group Mesh_Prov_Common_Exported_Functions

Functions exported for mesh provisioning.

Functions

bool prov_ctx_set_cnt(uint8_t cnt)

Set prov maximum parallel capability.

If the default value is not desired, this API shall be invoked before prov_params_set and mesh_init.

参数:

cnt -- [in] Parallel number.

返回值:

  • true -- If operation was successful.

  • false -- If operation failed; ensure the cnt value is valid for recovery.

返回:

Operation result.

void prov_ctx_set_def(prov_bearer_t bearer)

Set prov current environment.

This API is used to choose to operate the designated peer device by the bearer.

参数:

bearer -- [in] The provision bearer.

bool prov_params_get(prov_params_t params, void *pvalue, uint8_t len)

Get the provision parameters.

参数:

  • params -- [in] Type of parameters.

  • pvalue -- [in] Pointer to value.

  • len -- [in] Length of value.

返回值:

  • true -- If parameters were successfully retrieved.

  • false -- If retrieval failed; validate parameter types and lengths for recovery.

返回:

Operation result.

bool prov_params_set(prov_params_t params, void *pvalue, uint8_t len)

Set the provision parameters.

参数:

  • params -- [in] Type of parameters.

  • pvalue -- [in] Pointer to value.

  • len -- [in] Length of value.

返回值:

  • true -- If parameters were successfully set.

  • false -- If setting failed; check the validity of parameters and value size for recovery.

返回:

Operation result.

bool prov_auth_value_set(uint8_t *pvalue, uint8_t len)

Set the auth value.

The function shall be called at the appropriate time. The auth value shall be set with the appropriate length and data format.

参数:

  • pvalue -- [in] Pointer to auth value.

  • len -- [in] Length of the auth value.

返回值:

  • true -- If auth value was successfully set.

  • false -- If setting failed; check the value size and format for recovery.

返回:

Operation result.

bool prov_auth_value_change(uint8_t *pvalue, uint8_t len)

Change the auth value.

The function shall be called at the appropriate time. The auth value will be changed immediately.

参数:

  • pvalue -- [in] Pointer to new auth value.

  • len -- [in] Length of the new auth value.

返回值:

  • true -- If auth value was successfully changed.

  • false -- If changing failed; ensure the new value size and format are correct for recovery.

返回:

Operation result.

bool prov_auth_random_set(uint8_t random[])

Set the auth random value.

The function shall be called at the appropriate time.

参数:

random -- [in] Random value.

返回值:

  • true -- If random value was successfully set.

  • false -- If setting failed; validate the random size and format for recovery.

返回:

Operation result.

prov_auth_value_type_t prov_auth_value_type_get(prov_start_t *pprov_start)

Get the auth value type.

Different types of auth values are formatted differently according to the spec.

参数:

pprov_start -- [in] Provision start PDU.

返回:

Auth value type.

bool prov_disconnect(pb_adv_link_close_reason_t reason)

Disconnect the prov bearer.

The spec requires the provisioner to disconnect the bearer after the provisioning procedure. The mesh stack leaves the app to decide whether to disconnect at the case PROV_CB_TYPE_COMPLETE.

参数:

reason -- [in] Reason for disconnection; pb-adv bearer needs the disconnect reason.

返回值:

  • true -- If disconnection was successful.

  • false -- If disconnection failed; confirm the reason and bearer status for recovery.

返回:

Operation result.

bool prov_disconnect_by_ctx(prov_ctx_t *pprov_ctx, pb_adv_link_close_reason_t reason)

Disconnect the prov bearer.

The spec requires the provisioner to disconnect the bearer after the provisioning procedure. The mesh stack leaves the app to decide whether to disconnect at the case PROV_CB_TYPE_COMPLETE.

参数:

  • pprov_ctx -- [in] Designated device information.

  • reason -- [in] Reason for disconnection; pb-adv bearer needs the disconnect reason.

返回值:

  • true -- If disconnection was successful.

  • false -- If disconnection failed; check context and reason validity for recovery.

返回:

Operation result.

bool prov_send(prov_ctx_t *pprov_ctx, uint8_t *pdata, uint16_t len)

Send provisioning data.

参数:

  • pprov_ctx -- [in] Provisioning context information.

  • pdata -- [in] Provision data.

  • len -- [in] Provision data length.

返回值:

  • true -- If data was sent successfully.

  • false -- If sending failed; ensure data length and context are correct for recovery.

返回:

Operation result.
